user.title: User
user.description: Represents a user in the system, who can be an Admin, Investor, or Client.

deal.title: Deal
deal.description: Represents a financing deal for a client.

dealName.description: A descriptive name for the deal.

clientId.description: The ID of the client associated with this deal.

clientName.description: The name of the client (denormalized for display).

principal.description: The principal amount of the loan.

interestRate.description: The annual interest rate for the deal.

durationValue.description: The numeric value for the duration of the deal.

durationUnit.description: The unit of time for the deal's duration.

status.description: The current status of the deal.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the deal was created.

fundBatch.title: Fund Batch
fundBatch.description: A specific batch of capital from an investor or the platform, available for investment.

sourceId.description: The ID of the source (Investor's user ID or 'platform').

amount.description: The amount of capital in this batch.

remainingAmount.description: The amount of capital from this batch that is still available to be invested.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the funds were added.

investment.title: Investment
investment.description: Links an investor to a deal and the amount they invested.

investorId.description: The ID of the investor user.

dealId.description: The ID of the deal being invested in.

transaction.title: Transaction
transaction.description: Logs every financial transaction within the platform.

dealId.description: The ID of the deal related to this transaction (if applicable).

userId.description: The ID of the user related to this transaction (if applicable).

repayment.title: Repayment
repayment.description: Represents a repayment made by a client for a deal.

dealId.description: The ID of the deal this repayment is for.

clientId.description: The ID of the client making the payment.

lodgedAt.description: The timestamp when the client lodged the payment.

approvedAt.description: The timestamp when the admin approved the payment.

/fundBatches/{fundBatchId}.description: A ledger of all investable capital batches.

/investments/{investmentId}.description: Tracks which investor has invested in which deal.

/transactions/{transactionId}.description: A log of all financial transactions.

/repayments/{repaymentId}.description: Tracks client repayments that are pending or completed.
